headline: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra has half the API price of GPT-5.6 Terra
body: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra on Oct. 26, and its standard API prices are 50% lower than GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol, according to the release. Input tokens cost $1 per million and output tokens $5, compared to $2 and $10 for Claude Sonnet 5.5.
note: The company says the model is practical for automating high-volume work such as reading invoices and entering their information into accounting software.

evidence.text: API prices are half those of GPT-5.6 Terra.
Input tokens cost $1 per million, output tokens $5, compared to $2 and $10 for Claude Sonnet 5.5 and $2 and $12 for GPT-5.6 Terra.
OpenAI has released GPT-6.1 Terra, a new mid-range AI model at half the API price of its predecessor.

OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6.1 Terra, a new artificial intelligence (AI) model that costs half as much as two of its other models and is practical for automating high-volume work such as reading invoices and entering their information into accounting software, the company said in a Monday (Oct. 26) press release .
